purpose: Determine whether public primary sources provide a complete clean-room prescription for the historical SEOBNRv4 fundamental-QNM interpolation. This is a source-completeness gate, not a numerical proximity gate.

bohe_2017.citation: Bohé et al., Phys. Rev. D 95, 044028 (2017), arXiv:1611.03703v3, Sec. II.C (PDF p. 4) and Appendix B (PDF p. 20; source paper.tex lines 1250-1264)

berti_2006.citation: Berti, Cardoso, and Will, Phys. Rev. D 73, 064030 (2006), arXiv:gr-qc/0512160v2, Table II (PDF p. 36), Appendix E Eqs. (E1)-(E2) (PDF p. 37), and Table VIII (PDF p. 41)

berti_author_archive.citation: Berti author numerical l=2 archive, unversioned download pinned by content hash; fundamental file n1l2m2.dat

context_only_source.citation: Cook, Kerr Quasinormal Modes: s=-2, n=0--7, Zenodo 2650358, Version 1 (24 April 2019)
context_only_source.reason_excluded_from_historical_definiti: The data postdate the 2017 SEOBNRv4 publication and can validate Kerr values, but cannot define which data and interpolation choices the historical model used.

mandatory_requirements.description: The model source identifies interpolation of numerical fundamental-QNM results rather than an approximate analytic fit.
A public primary source or hash-pinned author asset identifies the exact historical spin-knot subset, complex (2,2,0) ordinates, and retained precision.
A public primary source specifies the interpolation family and order used by historical SEOBNRv4.
A public primary source specifies all endpoint boundary conditions needed to reproduce the interpolant.
A public primary source specifies the supported signed-remnant-spin interval and maps signed spin to the required Kerr QNM branch.
A public primary source specifies clamping, rejection, or extrapolation behavior outside the interpolation interval.

pass_rule: Every mandatory requirement must be satisfied by the pinned public primary sources. An approximate fit, an independent later dataset, a GPL implementation, or a binary-oracle match cannot fill a missing field.
clean_room_exclusions: Do not inspect or transcribe LALSimulation source or its QNM tables.
Do not query or fit to a LALSimulation binary oracle.
Do not promote the Berti analytic fit or Cook 2019 data to a historical-SEOBNRv4 prescription.
